_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 41: 10-15 December 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will pinch themselves at how much will be changed, even in 2028, and recalls telling them there would be an acceleration from the 23rd and that it would be the point of no return, saying now it will accelerate.
mentions.quote: YOU'RE GOING TO PINCH YOURSELF. THAT'S HOW MUCH it'll be changed
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: change with no measure.

mentions.claim_text: He asks where they would spend eternity if they died tonight, saying it could be their last night on earth, and notes they heard from the father tonight that hard days are coming, a great shaking to awaken.
mentions.quote: You could die tonight. Where will you spend eternity?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2026 will be the year of the events and 2027 too, that it was bringing the people in to bring stability and digital ID, and that they will say this is just the way it has to be.
mentions.quote: 2026 will be the year of the events
mentions.falsify_match: Crises used to justify digital identity rollout across 2026 and 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such rollout. The year of the events has no threshold, but the digital ID half is checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord wants them to keep going and come deeper, that for 2026 he is drawing the bride closer to his side, and that there are great days of shakings and awakenings coming.
mentions.quote: 2026, I'm drawing the bride closer to my side
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: drawing the bride closer has no measure.

mentions.claim_text: He says not to take it into the next marriage, that he sees a woman and just had a vision, that she is getting ready to get married and it will be a new transition.
mentions.quote: I see the woman. You're getting ready to get married
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice: any large audience contains someone about to remarry.

mentions.claim_text: He says this will take much prayer concerning the midterms and warns the church not to be foolish thinking they have got this just because Trump is at the helm.
mentions.quote: do not be foolish, church, thinking you just got this
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as an instruction, but it hedges red-wave-2026 by making the win conditional on effort.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees three judges and they must push through the Supreme Court judges, repeats three judges several times, and links it to the number three about February the 3rd.
mentions.quote: Remember the number three about February the 3
mentions.falsify_match: A three-judge Supreme Court matter on or near 3 February 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The link between the three judges and the third of February is numerological, and he says so.

mentions.claim_text: He prays coming boldly before the throne, repeating that the Lord says to come boldly and ask, and turns the word claim over into climb several times.
mentions.quote: Come boldly to my throne and ask me this
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He asks again whether the woman is even in Minnesota, says he does not know why he is seeing this and she may not be there at all, and anticipates being told he is missing it badly.
mentions.quote: Is that woman in Minnesota? I don't know why I'm seeing this
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as given, and he pre-empts the miss himself.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over Oklahoma again and says Texas had a major victory concerning the Supreme Court and the judges and the districts splitting up, calling it a major answer to prayer that gives more house seats in red areas.
mentions.quote: Texas had a major victory concerning the Supreme Court and the judges
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a report of a ruling that had already happened, credited to prayer after the fact.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are intercessors and that this is why the channel exists, so they will have a God-fearing nation that stands with Israel and prays for the peace of Jerusalem, and that they must have this.
mentions.quote: we will have a God-fearing nation that will stand with Israel
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a statement of the channel's purpose.

mentions.claim_text: He says of the judges that it is excel or derail, repeats it, and calls for prayer for the judges and 333, praying for the Supreme Court and major federal judges in 2026.
mentions.quote: You saw the judges. Excel or derail
mentions.falsify_match: Either judicial cooperation or judicial obstruction, which between them exhaust the possibilities.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a: excel or derail covers both outcomes, so nothing can miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says without them showing up they would just be praying by themselves, that he believes many hands make light work, gives glory to Jesus when they show up, and says they are really just plowing.
mentions.quote: many hands make light work
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: it makes the audience's attendance part of the mechanism.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when Trump started praying in the Holy Ghost in the Oval Office he took shock paddles and shocked them against the land, and that it brought a shock wave of life.
mentions.quote: When Trump started praying in the Holy Ghost in the Oval Office
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an image of a spiritual effect on a nation.

mentions.claim_text: He says to pray for the three judges, naming February 3rd, the Supreme Court and the number three, mentions an extension, major decisions concerning Europe and praying over the globe, and says there is more to this they need to see with judges on the fence.
mentions.quote: February 3rd, Supreme Court, the number three, extension
mentions.falsify_match: A major judicial decision on 3 February 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes without one. Fourth distinct thing now attached to February 3rd.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are notes there to keep track of and they will continue to pray, thanks God for the living word and for praying over Minnesota, and says they have made great ground in their area.
mentions.quote: praying over Minnesota. They've made great ground
mentions.falsify_match: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it is very heavy and he does not come out from under it until it is over, and asks for the word from Prophet Kim given on the 22nd of February 2014.
mentions.quote: if my son has the word from Prophet Kim
mentions.falsify_match: Another prophet's word from 2014 read in as support. Whether it says what he says it says is checkable outside this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was heavy and that in everything the Lord was showing him he said great darkness would come, that this concerns 2026, and that they are praying over this timeframe for an exposing and a cleaning of the church.
mentions.quote: great darkness would become this is concerning 2026
mentions.falsify_match: Church scandals surfacing through 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Great darkness has no threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying judgment begins in the house of the Lord first, that he is cleansing and cleaning up the church as a whole, and that in 2026 1 Corinthians 5:5 will be made manifest like they have never seen it before.
mentions.quote: in 2026, 1 Corinthians 5:5 will be made manifest
mentions.falsify_match: Ministers publicly falling through 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Made manifest is not defined.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in the last video he saw Cuba highlighted again but completely dark, that the Lord said to pay attention to Cuba because there is much darkness there, and that the prophetic words are starting to be just as the Lord told them they would.
mentions.quote: Pay attention to Cuba. There's much darkness here
mentions.falsify_match: A crisis in Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Darkness is not defined as blackout, unrest or spiritual condition.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in 2025 he saw the Pope getting involved with Zelensky and influencing the decisions made concerning Ukraine and Russia, that he said it was coming, that it was July the 6th, and that it happened today.
mentions.quote: It's July the 6th. It happened today
mentions.falsify_match: Papal involvement in Ukraine diplomacy reported on 11 December 2025, and a 6 July 2025 video saying so. Both halves checkable, the second from inside this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Zelensky being taken out and Ukraine split up to Kiev, with land given to Putin as an act of peace and a proxy government established.
mentions.quote: I saw Zalinsky being taken out
mentions.falsify_match: Zelensky removed and a partition of Ukraine with a proxy government.
mentions.falsify_miss: He remains, or a settlement without partition. Taken out is left ambiguous between removed from office and killed.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that God wants revival more than they do, and notes that Jerome Powell came out today and said they are going to lower it twenty five more basis points and it is going down.
mentions.quote: We're going to lower it 25 more basis points
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a report of a rate decision that had just been announced.

mentions.claim_text: He asks them to pray about a woman with him, says he is not trying to call it out and name her, but that he sees a brown-headed woman taking his job, and says he does not know who she is.
mentions.quote: I see a brown-headed woman taking his job
mentions.falsify_match: A brown-haired woman succeeding the man in question.
mentions.falsify_miss: A man succeeds him, or a woman of another description. Whose job is not stated in this passage, though the Powell remark precedes it.

mentions.claim_text: He says people should not judge him, that he may say some bad words but so do babies, that baby Christians mess up a lot which is why they are called babies, and that adult Christians should have their act together more.
mentions.quote: Baby Christians mess up a lot. That's why they're called babies
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a defence of a public figure's conduct.

mentions.claim_text: He says that during travail in the Oval Office he saw the glory of the Lord radiating out of there, because the Lord said if his people called by his name will humble themselves and pray and turn from their wicked ways, then he would hear from heaven.
mentions.quote: I SAW THE GLORY of the Lord radiating out of there
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a sight of glory over a building.

mentions.claim_text: They note that in 2026 it will be three years, he gives glory to Jesus, says yes he does see storms coming concerning 2026, and apologises for the video running over an hour.
mentions.quote: In 2026 it'll be three years
mentions.falsify_match: The channel's third anniversary, checkable against its start date.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is not a look thing but a heart thing, that he speaks highly of her because she truly is a treasure, and that he tries to be real and values these things.
mentions.quote: it's not a look thing, it's a heart thing
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: personal, about his wife.

mentions.claim_text: He leads a prayer for those believing God for a spouse, a godly man or godly woman, thanking God that in 2026 he is bringing their Esther or whatever they are believing for.
mentions.quote: in 2026, Father, I thank you that you're bringing my Esther
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice: some listeners will marry in 2026 and the rest are not counted.

mentions.claim_text: He describes Satan talking to businessmen about how to manipulate the economy and bring forth the beast system for the end times, trying to accelerate this in 2026 for digital IDs and a digital dollar to set it up.
mentions.quote: the devil was talking to these businessmen on how to manipulate the economy
mentions.falsify_match: Digital ID and central bank digital currency programmes advancing in 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: They stall. The scene itself is unobservable; only the policy half can be checked.
